reviews.review_title: Review at Truffle & Co. Mac Thi Buoi
reviews.review_text:
Priya
Male297 contributions
0
Food 1000/10
Jul 2026 • Couples
This restaurant is located just behind the hotel where we are staying. We noticed it had great reviews, so we decided to give it a try.

We both love Italian cuisine, and I think we’ve been eating Italian food almost every other day since arriving in Vietnam!

The food was absolutely incredible (1000/10.) The garlic butter was so delicious that I ended up eating far more bread than I planned! Every dish was excellent.

The service from the team was exceptional. I was pleasantly surprised that our server proactively asked about allergies and dietary restrictions before taking our order. She was knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely welcoming throughout our meal.

The restaurant itself has a cozy, quiet atmosphere that made for a very relaxing dinner. Honestly, I have no complaints about the food, service from our server, or the ambiance.

The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because of one experience that left me feeling disappointed. I had read several reviews mentioning that the manager personally greets guests and checks in on each table. During our nearly two-hour visit, I noticed her doing exactly that, walking around, chatting with guests, and making sure everyone was enjoying their meal. However, despite passing our table several times, she never greeted us, smiled, or checked in once.

I may be mistaken, but it left me feeling overlooked. As a South Asian guest, I couldn’t help but wonder if we were being treated differently. I sincerely hope that wasn’t the case, but it was the impression I was left with.

That said, the food, our server, and the overall dining experience were so good that my husband already wants to come back. I would happily dine at another branch, as the quality of the food and service truly deserves recognition.
Read more
Written July 29, 2026
Bono Yel
Thank you so much for this thoughtful and generous review — and for choosing to spend an evening with us during your time in Vietnam, especially with so much wonderful Italian food already on your trip! We're thrilled the pasta, the garlic butter (we're glad you gave in to the bread!), and every dish left such an impression, and we're so glad our server made you feel genuinely welcomed and looked after.

That said, we're truly sorry to hear you felt overlooked by our manager during your visit. Every guest deserves to feel seen and welcomed at Truffle & Co., without exception, and it troubles us that this wasn't your experience that evening. We take what you've shared seriously and will be addressing it directly with our team to understand what happened and ensure every table receives the same warmth and attention.

We'd really value the chance to speak with you further if you're open to it — please feel free to reach us at admin@truffleco.vn. And we're so glad to hear your husband is already looking forward to coming back; we'd love the opportunity to welcome you both again, at any of our branches, for the complete experience you deserve.

With sincere thanks and warm regards,
Truffle & Co. Team

Everything here is excellent, the service, the atmosphere, the staff and of course the quality of the food. Yes, it is certainly on the expensive side but so worth it.
